response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULL, tr.tradekind) AS kind, COUNT(DISTINCT x.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord x ON a.translink = x.transreg JOIN trader tr ON x.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), s AS (SELECT kind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.kind AS tradekind, s.cnt AS transaction_count, s.share AS share, s.share - av.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s, av WHERE av.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > av.avg_share
